audit_scope.description: Auditing CL fork transition (Fulu), CL beacon chain changes (EIP-7917 proposer lookahead, EIP-7892 blob schedule), and EL blob base fee reserve price (EIP-7918). Both EL and CL are materially present.

judging.severity_measurement: Impact on the entire Ethereum network
judging.poc_requirement_note: All submissions (except informational) must include an executable coded proof of concept at the time of submission

eips: EIP-7594: PeerDAS - Peer Data Availability Sampling
EIP-7823: Set upper bounds for MODEXP
EIP-7918: Blob base fee bounded by execution cost
EIP-7934: RLP Execution Block Size Limit
EIP-7935: Set default gas limit to XX0M

engine_api.description: EL-CL communication via Engine API is authenticated using JWT and considered semi-trusted
engine_api.rationale: Co-located EL and CL clients communicate via authenticated Engine API (JWT). The Engine API is considered a trusted boundary, but data returned by EL may not be fully verified by CL in all cases (e.g., blob data from engine_getBlobsV2 is used without KZG verification). If the EL is compromised or buggy, corrupted data may be propagated to the network.
security_implications: Engine API is authenticated via JWT
Some data from EL may be used without full verification by CL
Compromised EL can affect CL behavior
engine_api.note: Vulnerabilities in Engine API implementation are in-scope, but attacks requiring a compromised local EL may be considered conditional or lower severity

local_validator.description: Local validator configuration is under operator control and considered semi-trusted
local_validator.rationale: Local validator configuration is under operator control. Misconfigured or manipulated validator settings could cause incorrect node behavior.
local_validator.note: Configuration issues requiring operator error are typically out-of-scope

p2p_peers.description: P2P network peers are unauthenticated and considered untrusted
p2p_peers.rationale: P2P network peers are unauthenticated. Any node can join the network and send arbitrary protocol messages. All P2P input must be fully validated.
p2p_peers.note: Vulnerabilities exploitable via P2P network are high priority for bug bounty

Critical.criteria: Vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to:
examples: Exploit an EIP/specification or client bug to easily create an infinite amount of ETH which is finalized by the network
Take down the entire network by sending a single malicious on-chain transaction that ends up crashing all clients
Critical.impact: Entire network (>50% validators or all clients)
Critical.attack_vector: Single malicious on-chain transaction or network packet

High.criteria: Vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to:
examples: Trivially cause network splits affecting more than 33% of the network
Bring down more than 33% of the network by sending a single network packet or an on-chain transaction
High.attack_vector: Single network packet or on-chain transaction

Medium.criteria: Vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to:
examples: Trivially cause network splits affecting more than 5% of the network
Bring down more than 5% of the network by sending a single network packet or an on-chain transaction
Medium.impact: More than 5% of the network (or >1% of validators for slashing)
Medium.attack_vector: Single network packet or on-chain transaction

Low.criteria: Vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to:
examples: Trivially cause network splits affecting at least 0.01% of the network
Bring down more than 0.01% of the network by sending a single network packet or an on-chain transaction
Low.attack_vector: Single network packet or on-chain transaction

Informational.criteria: Observations or recommendations regarding code quality, maintainability, or system architecture that do not present a direct security risk
Informational.validity_requirement: Only applicable if the team decides to implement a change based on the report
notes: Informational issues are valid if they don't lead to a sufficient impact to count as Low or higher and are valuable enough for the client that they decided to implement the change in the code
Issues related to parts under the 'Out of scope' section will not be considered valid
Informational issues won't have duplicates, and only the first one is valid
They also don't qualify for the 1st and 2nd week multipliers, as they apply only to issues in the main pot

el_vectors.threat: Submit malformed transactions, resource exhaustion attacks, manipulate blob gas economics via reserve price mechanism (EIP-7918)
Eclipse attacks, send invalid blocks with incorrect excess_blob_gas values, exploit reserve price calculation discrepancies

cl_vectors.threat: Propose blocks exceeding dynamic blob limits, exploit proposer lookahead knowledge for targeted attacks, submit blocks with mismatched fork digests
Send blocks with invalid blob commitment counts, connect with spoofed fork digests to inject incompatible data
Return invalid execution payload verification results, corrupt blob data, provide incorrect base_fee_per_gas affecting reserve price calculation

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via Beacon P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P gossip and request-response (beacon_block, blob_sidecar topics)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers are unauthenticated. Any node can join and send arbitrary beacon blocks, including blocks with invalid blob commitment counts or mismatched fork digests. All data must be fully validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Remote Peer via P2P Discovery
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P peer discovery (ENR, fork digest advertisement)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Remote peers attempting connection may be on different blob parameter schedules or may spoof fork digests. Fork digest verification is the first trust boundary check.

trusted_external_entities.name: Execution Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. However, execution payload verification results from the EL are used by the CL to accept/reject blocks. A buggy or compromised EL could return incorrect verification results, affecting consensus.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Proposer (Validator) via P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Proposers are validators but their blocks arrive via untrusted P2P. A malicious proposer may include excessive blob commitments, exploit dynamic blob limits at epoch boundaries, or craft blocks targeting the reserve price mechanism.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via devp2p
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers send blocks containing excess_blob_gas headers. A malicious peer could send blocks with incorrect excess_blob_gas values computed under the wrong reserve price mode, attempting to cause validation divergence.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. The CL sends execution payloads to the EL for validation. The payload content (including blob gas fields) must still be validated by the EL against its own state.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full block validation required: verify blob_kzg_commitments count against dynamic blob limit from get_blob_parameters(epoch), verify execution payload via Engine API, verify proposer signature and slot assignment against proposer_lookahead.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P peer discovery and fork digest verification
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Fork digest must match local computation including blob parameter hash (EIP-7892). Peers with mismatched digests must be rejected to prevent network partition attacks.
CL must validate execution payload structure and blob commitments independently before trusting EL verification result. Content validation required even though channel is authenticated.
Proposer identity must be verified against proposer_lookahead vector. Block must pass all validation including dynamic blob commitment limit. Proposer signature must be valid.

Full block header validation required: recalculate excess_blob_gas using modified calc_excess_blob_gas with reserve price logic (EIP-7918) and verify it matches the header value. Must correctly determine reserve vs normal mode.

Execution payload must be fully validated against EL state including state transitions, gas calculations, and excess_blob_gas computation with reserve price logic. JWT authentication verifies channel but not content.
